description: Create an ACF field group with fields (active, shown in REST, labels on top)

key.description: Field key (default: field_ + md5(group key + name), so the same name keeps its key)

name.description: Field name (meta key; run through sanitize_title)

settings.description: Extra ACF field settings. Only these keys are kept: choices, other_choice, allow_null, multiple, placeholder, rows, new_lines, min, max, step, prepend, append, maxlength, conditional_logic, wrapper, return_format, display_format, first_day, library, min_size, max_size, mime_types, preview_size, taxonomy, field_type, save_terms, load_terms, add_term, save_other_choice, layout, sub_fields, min_rows, max_rows, button_label

type.description: ACF field type: text, textarea, number, email, url, image, file, wysiwyg, select, checkbox, radio, true_false, link, post_object, relationship, taxonomy, user, date_picker, color_picker, repeater, group, ... (default text)

hide_on_screen.description: Edit screen elements to hide (permalink, the_content, excerpt, featured_image, ...)

key.description: Field group key (default group_ + a UUID)

operator.description: Comparison operator: == or != (add-ons may register more)

param.description: Rule parameter (post_type, page_template, taxonomy, options_page, user_role, ...)

value.description: Value to compare against (e.g. post, page, product)

name: acf_create_field_group
